title: Range-Angle Position Estimator
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Direction of Arrival/Range_Angle_Position_Estimator.md
text: 使用距离-角度测量估计目标位置，输入 5 路、输出 2 路；{Enable known variance input}、{Output covariances of position estimates} 输出位置估计的协方差、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: RngEst
ports.summary: 距离测量（米） real-valued 1-by- K vector | real-valued J -by- L matrix

ports.name: AngEst
ports.summary: 到达角估计（度） real-valued 1-by- L row vector | real-valued 2-by- L matrix

ports.name: RngVar
ports.summary: 距离方差（米²） [] (default) | positive real-valued J -by- L matrix | positive real-valued length- K row vector

ports.name: AngVar
ports.summary: 角度方差（度²） [] | real-valued 1-by- L row vector | real-valued 2-by- L matrix

ports.name: AnchorPos
ports.summary: Anchor positions (meters) real-valued Q -by- J matrix

ports.name: TgtPosEst
ports.summary: 目标位置估计（米） real-valued Q -by-1 vector

ports.name: TgtPosCov
ports.summary: 估计的目标位置协方差（平方米） real-valued Q -by- Q matrix | real-valued Q -by- Q -by- K array

params.name: Enable known variance input
params.values: Enable known variance input on (default) | off

params.name: Output covariances of position estimates
params.values: 输出位置估计的协方差 off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
